data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate had gross material exposure to Typhoon Hagibis and Typhoon Faxai in the 2019 Year of Account. The net exposure to these losses are immaterial. Last year, the Syndicate had material exposure to the Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, the Camp and Woolsey Wildfires and the Lurssen Shipyard loss in the 2018 Year of Account. During the year, the exposure to Typhoon Jebi and Lurseen Shipyard have deteriorated; however, there has been an improvement for the Camp and Woolsey Wildfires. This increases the uncertainty in an adverse direction significantly beyond the normal range of uncertainty for insurance liabilities at this stage of development. By performing sensitivity analysis on the losses pertaining to these loss events, it was determined that a 10% increase on the gross reserves will have a minimal impact on the net reserves due to the reinsurance programme covering the affected classes of business. The Syndicate does not have any material exposure to these losses on any of the older years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 830.4m. The syndicate reports mixed prior-year development: certain 2018-year large losses (Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, Lurssen Shipyard) showed deterioration, while other 2018-year losses (Camp and Woolsey wildfires) improved. No single gross prior-year reserve movement figure for the portfolio is disclosed; management notes that a 10% increase in gross reserves for the events referenced would have minimal net impact given the reinsurance programme.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was located in the notes; the claims development triangle in the report appears in the Risk Management / Technical Reserves section but the extracted table was partially garbled. Prior-year direction is described narratively (some 2018 events deteriorated, others improved) but no aggregate gross PYD amount is given, so prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. LOB movements are computed as the change in gross claims outstanding between 31/12/2018 and 31/12/2019 (these are year-end outstanding movements, not a definitive 'prior year development' reconciliation). The report also references RITC activity (2017 RITC into 2018) which can distort development metrics; exercise caution using the claims triangle for PYD where RITC is present.
